toegepas.voor: siekte van mens tot mens trek
toegepas.na: siekte van mens tot mens versprei
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'trek' is not the natural verb for a disease passing between people; 'versprei' is.
toegepas.fout: 'trek' is an unnatural verb for a disease passing from person to person.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'versprei' is the natural verb here and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Avoids starting two consecutive sentences with 'Mense' and puts the linking word first for better flow.
toegepas.fout: Three sentences in a row lean on 'Mense', and 'daarom' sits awkwardly mid-sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Fronting 'Daarom' gives a clearer link to the previous sentence; 'hulle' can only point to 'Mense', same people and same claim.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'sommer' is colloquial; 'vanself' is the standard way to say something arises on its own.
toegepas.fout: 'sommer' is loose and colloquial for the idea of arising on its own.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'vanself' states the old belief (life arising by itself from dead matter) more exactly with no change in meaning.

toegepas.blok: Van vrot kos na 'n siek mens
toegepas.rede_vinder: Wine sours rather than rots; 'bederf' fits both nouns and matches the word 'bederf' used elsewhere in the lesson.
toegepas.fout: Wine does not 'vrot'; the verb fits only one of its two nouns.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'bederf' fits both food and wine and matches the lesson's own word 'bederf', without moving the claim.

toegepas.blok: Van vrot kos na 'n siek mens
toegepas.voor: Dit is die verband tussen kieme en siektes
toegepas.na: Dit is die verband tussen kieme en siekte
toegepas.rede_vinder: The lesson elsewhere says 'die verband tussen kieme en siekte'; using the same form keeps the phrase consistent.
toegepas.fout: The link is introduced as 'kieme en siektes' but named 'kieme en siekte' later in the lesson.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the same relation in the same form helps a Grade 6 reader see it is one link; the general sense is kept.

toegepas.blok: Van vrot kos na 'n siek mens
toegepas.voor: Daardie verband het 'n nuwe manier gegee
toegepas.na: Daardie verband het 'n nuwe manier gebied
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'het 'n manier gegee' without a recipient is wooden; 'het 'n manier gebied' is the natural collocation.
toegepas.fout: 'het 'n nuwe manier gegee' without a recipient reads wooden.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'het 'n nuwe manier gebied' is the natural collocation and says the same thing.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'manier van werk' calques 'way of working'; 'metode' is natural and grade-appropriate.
toegepas.fout: 'manier van werk' is a vague calque for a process like pasteurisation.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'metode' is the precise, grade-appropriate word; the protected 'is na Pasteur vernoem' stays intact and the sentence gets shorter.

na_skrywer.voor: Melk of 'n ander vloeistof word warm gemaak
na_skrywer.na: Wanneer melk of 'n ander vloeistof warm gemaak word
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A definition should describe the process rather than read as a stand-alone statement; the 'wanneer' form does this without changing the content.
na_skrywer.fout: The glossary entry reads as a statement about milk rather than defining the process it names.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may change it, and it also adds a word to a lesson near its ceiling.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: wat in die 1860's aan hierdie vraag gewerk het
vlae.rede: 'hierdie vraag' has no question to refer back to: the previous block states beliefs but asks nothing, so the reference is vague. Fixing it means naming the question, which needs the intended content.
